name: Klima
summary: Color-washed boathouses on the water. A slow pass, often at the start or end of the day.

name: Kalogries
summary: A pale cove on the northwest. Clear, shallow, easy water.

name: Gerakas
summary: A quieter fold of the island. Often a look, sometimes a swim.

name: Sykia
summary: A collapsed cave open to the sky. Best as a photo pass when the swell is kind.

name: Kleftiko
summary: The white-rock theatre. Swim through arches. The reason many people come to Milos by boat.

name: Polyaigos
summary: The uninhabited neighbour. Turquoise over white sand when the wind allows.

name: Arkoudes
summary: The bear-shaped islets off the north. A landmark more than a stop.

name: Sulphur mines
summary: Old workings and yellow cliffs on the east. A slow sail-by, not a landing.
